claim.purpose: Keep foreign Runtime v3 and nonexistent binary selectors out of ADL focused coverage

initial.title: [v0.91.7][tooling][CI] Remove foreign binary selectors from Runtime v3 CSM coverage
initial.goal: Make the bounded Runtime v3/CSM coverage route execute valid owning-crate expressions.
initial.required_outcome: The exact #5504 CI expression runs ADL-only and Runtime-v3-only coverage filters and composes both summaries.
authority_boundary: Issue #5512 owns only the focused coverage split and regression proof
Issue #5494 owns Runtime v3 and CSM implementation
initial.task_boundary: Repair the focused coverage filter without changing Runtime v2, production runtime behavior, or general coverage policy.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The exact run 29644007246 expression produces a valid ADL-only coverage invocation
AC-2: Runtime v3 selectors execute only through adl-runtime/Cargo.toml
AC-3: Both crate summaries remain composed
AC-4: Generic non-bridge coverage behavior remains unchanged
AC-5: No Runtime v2 source changes and no AWS
initial.plan_summary: Detect the already bounded bridge expression, substitute owning-crate filters, and lock the exact failure into the coverage contract test.

steps.action: Add the bounded owning-crate expression split
Add the exact CI failure regression and run focused validation
Review, publish, merge, and resume #5494 CI

risks: A broad detector could alter unrelated coverage routes
The ADL filter could omit intended CSM coverage
Summary composition could silently lose one crate
invariants: Only the already bounded Runtime v3/CSM bridge is specialized
Each crate receives only selectors it owns
stop_conditions: The repair requires Runtime v2 changes
The bridge cannot be identified from its closed selector family
review_prompts: Can a foreign binary selector still reach the ADL workspace?
Can the detector trigger for an unrelated expression?
Does the runtime companion retain auth, supervision, and topology coverage?

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove exact failed-expression repair and unchanged summary composition

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed if any foreign selector reaches an owning crate, the exact fixture is not exercised, either summary is omitted, or Runtime v2/AWS enters scope.
